results.content: The Republican party retains control of the House of Representatives with a slim majority. Republicans currently hold 218 seats while the Democrats have 214. As of August 31, 2026, there are two vacant seats in the House due to the resignations of Rep. Tony Gonzales (R-Texas) and Rep. Sheila Cherfilus-McCormick (D-Florida). A special election to fill the seat of Rep. Eric Swalwell (D-Calif.) was held on Aug. 18, 2026, with Democrat Aisha Wahab winning the election against Melissa Hernandez. [...] Melissa Hernandez. There was a runoff election on Aug. 25, 2026, to fill the seat of Rep. David Scott (D-Georgia), with Democrat Everton Blair winning the election to serve out the rest of the term.

# James Talarico continues to edge out Ken Paxton in Texas’ U.S. Senate race, new poll finds

The latest University of Texas/Texas Politics Project poll shows Democratic state Rep.
